title: Sharp styling and lost edge
summary: Feedback in this topic combines praise for sharp-looking design with comments about the car losing the character, refinements, or details some reviewers expected.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's sharp styling, good looks, comfort, and interior tech.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says a sharp edge feels dangerous.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention lost door engraving, lost refinements, losing its way, and a lost phone connection, but the sample does not support a single clear sentiment interpretation across these fragments.

limitations: The cluster mixes exterior styling comments with unrelated issues such as missing trim details and phone connection loss.
Several example fragments labeled positive or undetermined contain wording that appears contradictory, so the supplied sentiment labels limit how precisely the theme can be interpreted.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all feedback on this topic.
